verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's documented public Marketing API powers marketing campaigns and has a documented 'Send a Mailchimp campaign' endpoint, so sending a campaign without the dashboard is evidenced. Creating a campaign and scheduling it for a future time via the API are not explicitly documented in the pack; the only schedule mention is that RSS campaigns follow their own schedule. Missing for 10: an explicit campaign-creation endpoint, an explicit schedule/unschedule endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API-only workflow.
